marcadores.explicacao_original: Tonsils consists of aggregations of diffuse and nodular lymphoid tissues located in the lamina propria of the oral and pharyngeal mucosae. They are partially surrounded by a connective tissue capsule. The three types of tonsils (palatine, pharyngeal and lingual) form a ring, called “Waldeyer’s ring”, around the entrances of the nasal and oral cavities into the pharynx.
